channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Customs agency says tariff refund system will be ready in 45 days
item.description: The U.S. customs agency is readying a system within 45 days to process refunds on President Donald Trump’s tariffs that were struck down as illegal and importers will not have to sue for them, a customs official said in a court filing today.

item.title: U.S. economy loses jobs in February; jobless rate rises to 4.4%
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The U.S. economy unexpectedly lost jobs in February and the unemployment rate increased to 4.4%, potentially hinting at a deterioration in labor market conditions that could put the Federal Reserve in a difficult spot amid rising oil prices.

item.title: Man, 55, arrested after woman critically hurt in Kapolei stabbing
item.description: A 55-year-old man was arrested for second-degree attempted murder on Thursday afternoon after a woman was found with multiple stab wounds in Kapolei.

item.title: Former U.S Rep. Colleen Hanabusa dies at age 74
item.description: Colleen Hanabusa, a former state lawmaker and prominent labor lawyer from Waianae who served in Congress but failed at bids to become Hawaii’s governor and Honolulu’s mayor, died today, her family confirmed. She was 74.

item.title: Pentagon designates Anthropic a supply chain risk
item.description: The Pentagon slapped a formal supply-chain risk designation on artificial intelligence lab Anthropic on Thursday, limiting use of a technology that a source said was being used for military operations in Iran.

item.title: Russia is reportedly providing Iran intelligence to target U.S. forces
item.description: Russia is providing Iran with targeting information that includes locations of U.S. warships and aircraft in the Middle East, the Washington Post reported today, citing three officials familiar with the intelligence.

item.title: Gas prices jump again as oil tops $90 for first time in years
item.description: Gasoline prices in the United States jumped again today, the latest in a series of increases that have pushed up the price of a gallon by 34 cents, or about 11%, since the start of the war led by the United States and Israel against Iran.

item.title: Eddie is a no-go, with season holding period ending today
item.description: The Rip Curl Eddie Aikau Big Wave Invitational is a no-go this season, with waves and conditions not meeting requirements, according to organizers.

item.title: Neiman Marcus store at Ala Moana Center to close
item.description: Saks Global is closing the Neiman Marcus department store at Ala Moana Center as part of ongoing restructuring efforts, the luxury retailer said in a news release today.

item.title: HPD closes illegal gambling operation on Date Street
item.description: Honolulu Police Department officers arrested one individual and seized multiple gaming machines, cash, possible illicit drugs, and drug-related paraphernalia using a search warrant at an illegal gambling establishment on Date Street in McCully.
